source_not_available.why: GET /api/results/displayed/dispatch refuses with 422 `?source=ac_pf` when no AC power flow is on record, because the old routes would fall back to the live LP network and the view would bind LP data under an ac_pf label (assistant assurance 06, A5.2 S3b-2); the tab then shows its unavailable state, and the assistant runs the AC power flow or answers from lopf.
